description: Publishes and changes public forms that let anyone outside the workspace add a record to a list without signing in. Each list has at most one form. Submissions create a record in that list as the member who last turned the form on, with the form named as its source in the record's activity; a submission from an email address that already has a record in the list creates no second record, and its answers are kept; an optional linked person is found or created by email (one person per email). action fields lists the fields a form can use (input fields of type text, formatted text, number, currency, yes/no, date, single or multiple choice, link and contact details) and the people lists it can link to. action create requires typeId, name and config. action update requires id and replaces config when given. action disable turns the form off at once; the same link works again after update with enabled true. Free plan forms accept a monthly number of submissions and show a Made with Customermates badge; paid plans and self-hosted workspaces have neither. A workspace administrator can turn public links and forms off in the workspace settings. Each get, create and update result carries url, the public link, and embedSnippet, an iframe to paste into a web page. Visitors see only the questions in config.fields, not other fields of the record.

action.description: Form operation. Keys per action: list: typeId; get: id; fields: typeId; create: typeId, name, config, enabled; update: id, name, config, enabled; disable: id.

config.description: The full form definition: title, description, submitLabel, fields (fieldId, label, helpText, required), person (find or create a person by email and link it), consent (text and privacyUrl), success (message and redirectUrl) and locale. Required for create; on update it replaces the stored definition.

privacyUrl.description: Link to the owner's privacy notice.

text.description: The sentence the visitor agrees to. A change creates a new consent version.

fields.description: The questions, in order. Every field the list requires and gives no default value must be among them, otherwise no submission can be saved.

fieldId.description: A field of the list. Only input fields of the supported types can be used.

helpText.description: Short hint under the input, or null.

label.description: The question shown to the visitor.

locale.description: The language of the page, or null to follow the visitor's browser.

nameFieldId.description: The text field of the people list that receives the name. Null stores no name.

nameLabel.description: Label of the optional name input, or null for no name input.

relationshipId.description: A relationship between the form's list and the people list.

typeId.description: The list that holds people. It needs a contact details field.

redirectUrl.description: Where to send the visitor after sending, or null to show the message.

enabled.description: create (default true) and update. Turning a form on needs public links allowed.

id.description: The form id. Required for get, update and disable.

name.description: Internal name of the form, shown as the source of the records it creates.

typeId.description: The list the form belongs to. Required for fields and create; optional for list.

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: manage_forms

outputSchema.description: list returns items; get, create, update and disable return the form with its public url and embedSnippet; fields returns the fields a form can use and the people lists it can link to.

title: Manage public forms
